result.paraphrase: Samsung 860 Series MZ-76P256E solid state drive with 256 GB capacity and 2.5-inch form factor. Uses SATA-6Gbps interface, 3D multi-level cell (MLC) NAND flash, and 512 MB buffer. Supports WWN and IEEE 1667 standards, plus TRIM, sleep mode, 3D V-NAND, auto garbage collection, eDrive, Samsung MJX controller, low-power DDR4 SDRAM cache, S.M.A.R.T., and 256-bit AES encryption. Performance specs include 600 Mbps external transfer rate, 560 Mbps read and 530 Mbps write internal data rates, 100000 IOPS maximum 4KB random read, and 90000 IOPS maximum 4KB random write.
